notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Omen Hawker's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
